description: This file implements a webhook server for Nextcloud Talk integration, handling incoming webhook requests, signature verification, message decoding, and server lifecycle management.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Formats an error object or string into a string message.

methods.name: normalizeOrigin
methods.description: Converts a URL string to its origin in lowercase, or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: parseWebhookPayload
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a NextcloudTalkWebhookPayload object using schema validation.

methods.name: writeJsonResponse
methods.description: Sends a JSON response with specified status and body.

methods.name: writeWebhookError
methods.description: Sends an error JSON response if headers are not sent.

methods.name: validateWebhookHeaders
methods.description: Validates webhook headers and backend allowance, returns headers or null.

methods.name: verifyWebhookSignature
methods.description: Verifies the webhook signature and manages rate limiting on failure.

methods.name: decodeWebhookCreateMessage
methods.description: Decodes webhook payload to determine if it's a create message, ignore, or invalid.

methods.name: payloadToInboundMessage
methods.description: Converts webhook payload to an inbound message object.

methods.name: readNextcloudTalkWebhookBody
methods.description: Reads the request body with size limit before signature verification.

methods.name: createNextcloudTalkWebhookServer
methods.description: Creates an HTTP server to handle Nextcloud Talk webhooks, with start and stop controls.

methods.name: monitorNextcloudTalkProvider
methods.description: Sets up and manages the webhook server lifecycle for a Nextcloud Talk account.
